'''CL-A1 Alderinium Cylinoid''' was an ammunition container used during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Holding a small quantity of refined [[Alderinium]] pellets, it was placed into CL-A1 Combat Clip designed to rapidly fill shells with material fed from a cylinoid, which was then connected to the power component of a combat rifle via CL-A1 Transfer Coil.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
CL-A1 Alderinium Cylinoid appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Trooper class mission on [[Quesh]].
